About

I’m a Bachelor of Science in Information Technology student at Central Bicol State University of Agriculture–Sipocot, with graduation expected in June 2027. I’m focused on backend development and building practical web applications.

I enjoy turning everyday problems into useful systems. My projects include a passenger booking and vehicle dispatching application, and a boarding house management app. I work with Node.js, TypeScript, MySQL, and Prisma to build the logic behind them.

I’m actively seeking an OJT opportunity where I can apply my skills, contribute to a team, and learn from experienced developers. Outside of coding, I enjoy traditional art, charcoal portraits, and video editing.
